author: Forbes
description:
Rolls-Royce Motor Cars has cemented its status as a true global "house of luxury." With the launch of Project Nightingale, the marque’s first-ever Coachbuild Collection, CEO Chris Brownridge reaffirms a definitive strategy to create "value, not volume". Strictly limited to 100 handcrafted motor cars worldwide, this extraordinary collection is available by invitation only to the world's most discerning collectors.

The engineering and design of Project Nightingale bridges 120 years of heritage with near-silent, all-electric technology. Standing at an imposing 5.7 meters long, the vehicle’s "torpedo" silhouette (defined by an expansive bonnet and a gracefully tapered rear) is directly inspired by the brand's 1928 experimental 17EX. The project’s name is a historic tribute to Le Rossignol (French for "the nightingale"), the designers' house located at co-founder Henry Royce's French Riviera estate.
